# The law of the lattice

The one document of the law: what the engine computes, in whole numbers,
and why. It states the law's lines, each with its status word, and nothing
else: how a line was reached, who derived or checked it, when and where,
stands outside this document, in the repository's history, its issues and
ledger. A line's status word is its whole claim: derived,
theorem, assumption, declared, computed, fitted, a hypothesis under its own
name, a finding by name, open by name, decided. Every symbol is named in
English where it first appears. A scalar is written plain, a vector in bold
lowercase (**n**), a matrix or an operator in bold uppercase (**C**). A line
that no longer holds is not in this document's body: since the owner's word of
2026-10-25, 23:1x UTC ("go for it", on the Scribe's proposal), it stands, dated,
in the closing section The former clauses, kept by name, and the body holds every
formula once, in its final form, with the short derivation from the hands by name
(the re-cut proceeds section by section beside the engine's cleaning, The Node and
the sign row's write first; no law sentence changes without the owner's word). An id of the form R42 or W11
beside a clause names a finding of the project's review, kept outside this tree.
A decision named beside a line is in force as docs/HIGHLIGHTS.md records it.

## The postulates

*If everything that is seen is formulas of physics, then perhaps reality is in fact only numbers, whole numbers.* (The owner's sentence of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in translation, set at the head by his word; his first person plural rendered in the passive, "is seen", by the Scribe's word rule.)

The one central place of the project's postulates (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in the session, verbatim in translation: "unify all the places into one central place, at the head of some file, and make sure the postulates hold the most important thing in the world: that reality is built of very, very many Nodes, and they are not managed from a central place, and therefore they must keep locality, because there are simply 10 to the power of a crazy number of such Nodes; that is the most important postulate. The postulate after it, because all of it is seen after it: that the reality seen is whole numbers only; and the reason for the whole numbers is that it is cleaner, more ordered, and reversible in time, and it must be reversible in time. Make sure the two postulates enter, and unify all the postulates into one central place everyone knows."; the owner's first person plural rendered in the passive, "is seen", by the Scribe's word rule). Every line of the law below is read against these; **The laws not to be crossed** are their letter in the acts; a postulate changes only by the owner's word, the former kept by name and dated.

**Postulate 1, the many Nodes and no centre, so locality** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:4x UTC; the most important postulate): reality is built of very, very many Nodes, 10 to the power of a huge number of them, and they are managed from no central place; therefore every Node must keep locality: it reads itself and its six neighbours through its six Links and nothing further, it holds bounded information of its own, and no act, read, write or refusal reaches beyond one Link; nothing global exists in the law, no board-wide reading, no centre, no list that grows with the world.

**Postulate 2, whole numbers, for the reversibility of time** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:4x UTC; the second, because everything after it is seen through it): the reality that is seen is whole numbers only, at the Nodes and nowhere else; the reason for the whole numbers is that they are cleaner and more ordered, and that the law is then reversible in time, every act a bijection on the integers with its remainder kept, the run back the same acts in the reverse order, bit for bit; and it must be reversible in time.

**Postulate 3, the Nodes speak at the speed of light at most** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in translation: "the Nodes speak to one another at the speed of light at most, and therefore the speed of light cannot be passed"): a Node's word reaches its neighbour through one Link in one interval and no further, so every act travels one Link per interval at most, the causal speed one Link per interval is built in, and nothing in the law passes it; every other speed is a count of Links over a count of intervals, below it.

**Postulate 4, nature is cyclic and information does not vanish** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in translation: "nature is cyclic; it does not freeze, it does not vanish; everything in nature is cyclic, and information does not vanish, not in the clicks and not anywhere"): the world returns, the bang recurs and no Node stays frozen for ever (FR-S1); no integer of the state is lost at any act, the clicks included, every click booked on the record and undone by the run back bit for bit, so what the world holds at one interval is held, moved or booked at the next and never erased.

**The ten postulates of 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25** (the owner's words, approved 2026-10-25, 08:5x UTC; moved here as written from docs/HIGHLIGHTS.md on 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC; postulates 1, 3 and 4 the two above in the words of their day):

1. The world is numbers and Nodes: nature is described by equations, so here it is whole numbers at Nodes and nothing else.
2. The Node is dumb and generic: a place on the torus with six Links, the same tens of integers at every place, knowing no body, mass, well, family, birth or click; a law not to be crossed; every act of the Node is one act on every row alike, and an act is atomic to the row or atomic to the Node, no third kind (19:0x and 19:1x UTC).
3. One Link: every act reads the Node and its six neighbours and nothing further; a change two Links away leaves the Node's interval bit for bit.
4. Rule3 alone and the same acts always: one fixed list of acts per interval, each one division with a carried remainder, every one a bijection but the writing of a line; backward the same acts in the reverse order.
5. The click is a line: where the Node reads a whole quantum (one division by the unit) it moves the quantum within its own lines and writes what it read, its own clock, the position, the point, the momentum, the sense, the count, or a refusal by name.
6. The loader lays the seeds and reads the universe's constants, den, Gamma, T and the lines' pairs as numbers (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 17:3x UTC; to that hour the three integers alone, the law keeping it by name), and a shape; after that everything happens by itself; nothing is declared by name, no body, no detector, no family's name.
7. All physics is in the decoder: it receives only the Node's clock and the position with what the click read, as an observer in nature does, and infers the rest, the clock shifts, the bound bodies, the families, light, general relativity, the uncertainty principle; it stands at a place, a detector Node reading its own credits; what does not show in the clicks is not in the world; den's circle, the masses and the names are the decoder's and never the board's.
8. 128 bits: every integer of the state and of every act's transient; den the one exception, a constant of the universe that may hold more, chosen by its structure, and no den of nature is needed (the owner's words of 04:1x and 18:1x UTC; the clause "den is chosen within them" struck 19:0x UTC and kept by name in the law).
9. Everything emerges: families, masses, charge, bodies and wells are the decoder's readings of clicks over several Nodes and several intervals; the mass appears at the click and nowhere on the board; a bound body is spread over several Nodes and clicks at its rim.
10. The law changes only with the owner's word, the old kept by name and dated; two hands derive blind before any code or document; what does not match nature is named, never hidden.

**The former form of the postulates, 2026-10-17, kept by name** (the premise and the seven as they stood under What the law says of nature, moved here as written on 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC; the detector's report and its draw in postulates 1, 3, 5 and 6 read since 2026-10-25 as the Node's own close and its read of its own remainders, **The Node**):

The premise of the seven, the owner's postulate (an assumption, declared 2026-10-17): nature is always described by equations, by mathematics and by physics, so the world is taken to be only numbers; a world that is only numbers and full of Nodes has every Node doing one operation on whole numbers; the postulates start from there. 1. NodeState, fixed in size, read from itself and its six neighbours; no read
beyond them, no list that grows with the world, nothing of the past kept.
Every physical update uses its own record and the six causally available

and causal: an Event first changes its own Node and travels Link by Link,

4. The causal speed is one Link per interval, built in; every
other speed is a rational, a count of Links over a count of intervals. 5.
Every physical calculation is on bounded integers; there is no float, no root and no draw in the law, the draw the instrument's by its read of the board (2026-10-20; "with its declared seed", history); a Node keeps only the law's own numbers: each
part's two levels and Rule3's remainder (a family of quanta's real pair
and its second, the rotation sense; a held family's parts), a held part's
one write remainder, the family's pair and the Node clock from the content
there, and nothing else; its count, its sense, its currents and its tension are readings. 6. A measurement is a detector's click, a
reading of the state: the net current into the declared region through its front boundary Ports over
one interval, reported with the region and the family and never a Node; one quantum is credited to one detector by the shares, the instrument's draw by its read of the board (2026-10-20; "with its declared seed", history), the instrument's declaration (for a record of two parts the share the joint share, the parts paired through the root and squared, [the click is the meeting](#the-click-is-the-meeting)), the realised click written at the one Node from which the quantum reached the detector, the instrument's act and the one write outside the reversal, and which meeting is realised is not derived. Only a click is compared with nature or pinned as an expectation; displays and the host's readings read state and write nothing.
7. The Inside is the lattice, where no one measures, deterministic and bit-reversible between clicks, holding the future with no arrow; the Outside is the detectors and their clicks, realised events, the detectors bodies of the board with two sides and the clicks carrying the arrow, the only thing claimed to represent nature. **Alignment, 2026-10-25** (the owner's word of 07:3x UTC GitHub's clock through the Boss, #2187 comment 6394916321): the seven postulates stand as written in their premise and are carried by HIGHLIGHTS.md's postulates of 2026-10-25; the detector's report and its draw in postulates 1, 3, 5 and 6 read since as the Node's own close and its read of its own remainders (**The Node**), the former wording kept by name.

## The lattice and the families

**The Node** (the owner's sentence, 2026-10-25, 03:4x to 05:1x UTC, "closed"; decided; the head of the law, every line below it read against it; the former paragraph **The objects** kept by name under it as the lattice's words): a Node is a place on the torus with six Links, one through each of its six Ports to one neighbour; it has no name, number or role and differs from another place in its position and its values alone. A Node holds a fixed state: the same integers, in the same count and the same width, at every Node and at every interval, for ever, no birth adding a row (lines of the Node's own, each two levels and one remainder, and the holders' write remainders; no record, no family, no identity, no counter of its history). A Node sees one Link: all it reads is its own levels and its six neighbours' through its six Links; a change two Links away leaves its interval bit for bit. A Node does one thing: at every interval the same list of acts, none conditioned on what was born at it, each one division with a carried remainder, every one a bijection but the writing of a line: Rule3 on each of its lines from the six arrivals; the holders' writes from its own lines (the volume's level from their form and tensions, the sign's row from their Wronskian, the rotation of the lines by the potential read through the Links); the swap at a weak maximum of its own level; the read of each Link once (the two ends' digits, one number the same from both ends, divided by the unit once, the remainder the whether and the quotient the pick), a whole quantum from each end laying a child at each end at opposite senses and taking from the light at each end what the lay books, refused by name where the light cannot pay, so a Node takes up to six children in one close, one per Link; and the close, a line standing at a whole quantum of its unit through one period of its own upward zero crossings writing a credit line with what the Node read (the point from three levels, the three momentum pairs, its own clock, the support, the sense, the count) or a refusal by name. Backward the same acts in the reverse order on the same numbers. A Node knows nothing: not a body, a mass, a well, a family, a birth, a click or a charge; these are the decoder's readings of credit lines over several Nodes and several intervals, as nature's observers read nature, and the mass appears at the click and nowhere on the board. Every integer of the state and of every act's transient stands within 128 bits (the owner's word, 2026-10-25, 04:1x UTC: no den of nature is needed); den is the one exception, a constant of the universe that may hold more (the owner's word of 18:1x UTC, the strike approved 19:0x UTC), its size bounded by the transients it makes, Rule3's total and the walls, which stay within 128; den is chosen by its structure, the primes 1 mod 4 and their powers, and no larger than what shows the phenomenon; the former sentence, den bounded by the width (the wall 6 den Gamma^2 G^2 within 128 bits, den near 2^101 at Gamma 1,000 and G 16), kept by name and dated 04:1x to 18:1x UTC. The loader lays the seeds on the board and reads the universe's constants and a shape; everything after is the Nodes' acts. (The head stands as the owner closed it; its reading since: the close at one period of the re line's zero crossings in either direction, CK-S1, and the plane at the gap 0 never credited as a body, The light no body, by his word of 17:57 UTC; the universe holding the lines' pairs by his word of 17:3x UTC; the seed in four forms by his word of 17:57 UTC; re-cut to the head by his word of 23:1x UTC, the former clauses in the closing section.)

### The laws not to be crossed

**Every act of the Node is one act on every row alike** (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 19:0x UTC, through the Boss; a law not to be crossed): no act, no write, no read, no refusal and no threshold names a row or holds for one row and not another; what differs between the rows is their pair, the number the universe gave them, and nothing else; an act that is true of one row alone is a name in disguise and is refused (so the orientation by the current at every birth, the threshold at the vacuum's weight for every line, the volume's factor in every line, the [1, 0] line included where it is times 0).

**The two kinds of act** (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 19:1x UTC, "closed"; a law not to be crossed): an act of a row is atomic to the row, it reads and writes the row's own three integers at the Node and the same row over its six Links and nothing of another row (the rotation by Rule3, the swap at the top, the read of a whole quantum); an act that joins rows is atomic to the Node, one sum or one exchange over every row of the list alike, no row named (the held write, the volume from every row's form and the sign from every plane's Wronskian; the click, one quantum from one row into another by the quotient); there is no third kind of act.

**One function steps a line; the Node is five functions; the code is folded** (the owner's words of 2026-10-25, 07:1x to 07:3x UTC GitHub's clock, through the Boss, #2187 comments 6394788306, 6394953355 and 6394968280; a law not to be crossed): the Node is five functions and nothing else: rotate(row), Rule3 on the row's lines from the six Links' numbers turned as the row's shape turns them, one carried division per line, the same function at -1 the inverse, a plane that function on two lines with the phase as an input and the riding line that function with the wall w X as an input; write(rows), the held write over the list; swap(row), the exchange at the top and the floor; click(rows), the close over the list; and link(i, j), the Link's one act, which takes the two ends' integers and returns the Link's numbers read the same from both ends, the even parts (the factor Q_ij, the tension, the pace) alike and the odd parts (the current F_ij, the count n_ij) with the opposite sign, called once per Link per interval from the Node's loop over its six Ports, nothing else reading a Link. The acts on the shapes are each one function of the shape's lines (the cube's 48 on a row, the metric's ten, the potential's four and the plane's two turned as one object; the trace and the traceless parts; the axis and the shear parts; the Wronskian and the currents of a plane; the sense's exchange), and no vector or tensor arithmetic is written twice or inline; the loader, the writer and the decoder are each one module that calls the Node's functions and the shapes' functions and holds no act of its own. Two functions that step a line, or a second place that does what a function does, are a refusal (ENGINE.md, the head of the list, and the gate that counts the definitions).

**Locality is never broken** (the owner's law of 2026-10-25, 07:5x UTC GitHub's clock, through the Boss, #2187 comment 6395138363; a law not to be crossed): a Node reads itself and its six Links and nothing else, forward and backward, in every act and in every reading the engine makes of a Node; no act fires on the whole board, no act reads a global, no inverse looks beyond one Link; an act that needs the board is refused. **Only local** and **The interval's dependency radius is one Link** stand under it. The gate: the one-Link reach test runs forward and backward on every check (a change two Links away leaves a Node's interval and its inverse bit for bit); the Scribe reads locality first in every commit. Locality act by act (the owner's word of 08:0x UTC GitHub's clock, #2187 comment 6395170656): the cone of a click, a Node's state after one interval depending on the Node and its six neighbours alone, forward and back, so a click's effect travels one Link per interval; the draw, the whether from the Node's own remainders and the which from one Link's digit (**The click's read of the board**); the quantum taken, one whole unit of the light at the Node and its six Ports and nothing beyond (the exact take); the arrow, the click logged at its Node and undone there by the run back; the correlation of two clicks (Bell, GHZ), the record laid locally and read locally at two detectors, the correlation in the decoder's whole view and no act between the two Nodes (**Tsirelson's bound is a theorem of the credit's form**, derived on 4.0's declared worlds, to re-derive under the generic Node, named open). The black hole on one Node: at the horizon a Node fed to the wall Gamma on one Link has that Link's factor 0, its two ends decoupled, holds on that axis, is read by no meeting and births nothing, no click; the tension fed to fall again re-couples the Link; a Node at the frozen content is not read and never clicks; the turn is the swap at a fed weak maximum, every line exchanged and every remainder complemented at its wall, the swap applied twice the identity, the run back through the turn returning the fed state bit for bit (ENGINE.md, the two black-hole rows).

**The Node and the Link are generic; there is no if** (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 09:3x UTC, in the session, to the Scribe; a law not to be crossed; his choice "1" of 10:4x UTC, #2187 comment 6396666564, a case by number lawful): the code of the Node and of the Link holds no branch on a row: no if for light, no row known by a name, a role or its place in the list; the shape and the pair decide everything, and a case by number (the quantum's unit 3 T s for s = sqrt(den^2 - num^2) and 3 den T where s = 0, the gap-0 row, the drift's double root; the Wronskian a sum over a row's pairs of lines, 0 for one line; the write's sources by shape) is the law's own; no unit, wall or threshold of one row held apart from the others' but by such a case; a Node and a Link do not know what they run, and the families stand in the universe file and the world file alone. **No act and no reading of the Node names a row: the shape and the pair decide everything; the one-Link read takes every line of every row at the start of the interval** (the owner's words of 09:3x and 09:4x UTC, #2187 comments 6396069205 and 6396103597, "go with A if it is generic and solves"; the hand gn1 and the Boss's rulings): a row is a shape and a pair, or a wall of its own (the phase row, no Links), as the universe file lists it and nothing else, the held rows the file's rows too (the shape-10 row at the clock's one level (den - den div Gamma, den), the shape-4 row at (den, den), the loader refusing a file off them or without exactly one of each by name); what a row reads and writes is a function of its shape (the shape-10 row written from the form and the tensions of every row that divides at its wall, the carrier itself and the walled row excepted; the shape-4 row from the Wronskian and the current of every two-line row; a row of one line has no bilinear), and what turns its arrivals a function of its pair; a row's unit is one function of its pair, largest_below(9 T^2 (den^2 - num^2)), the massless unit 3 den T its case at the gap 0 by number; the two records of a pair are told apart by the sign of their own Wronskian at the Node, read and never indexed, the file's order of the two conjugate rows carrying nothing; a lay names its row by its index in the universe file and not by the pair; the one-Link read takes every line of every row at the interval's start alike, the walled row's line and the held rows' every line among them, on the Node and its six neighbours and nothing else, each line's remainder on its own row's lattice, the room on the birth line its count. **The row's name** (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 14:1x UTC in the session, verbatim in translation: "that is not the name, massless"): the law's current letter names no row by a property; a row is its shape and pair, and the row the sentences before this day called the massless line or the massless row is the plane at the gap 0, the pair (den, den), the row at the gap 0 in every new line; every earlier sentence that reads the former name is kept as written and dated in the closing section and reads so; no new line writes the name.

**The interval is one function of the Node** (the owner's word of 2026-10-25, 10:5x UTC, through the Boss, #2187 comment 6396777916): the interval is one function of a Node's fixed state and its six neighbours' state, no read beyond one Link, no global, no board-wide act, the swap's trigger, the click, the lay and the write all at the Node; every integer within 128 bits; the count of integers per Node fixed for the run; every Node stepped by the same function in one synchronous pass; the run back the same function at -1; nothing in the Node's step allocates, names, logs or branches on a row's identity, the log and the decoder reading the state after the step, outside the Node. The engine's port to a GPU follows this form and needs nothing of the law to change. **The Node steps on its own clock; the board at equal ticks is one** (the owner's word of 07:2x UTC GitHub's clock, #2187 comment 6394878316): the Nodes are stepped in any order and at different paces, one Node run ahead by many ticks and its neighbours behind, each Node stepping only when the arrivals it needs from its six neighbours stand; ### The line

Rule3 is named for the three axes of the lattice, the three directions of the vector the rule works with: the Link's paces (p_x, p_y, p_z) are that vector, and the line has one read coefficient per Port, R_ij = 2 num p_i^2 q_ij^2 / Gamma^2 on the Link to that neighbour, the Node's pace squared times the Link's factor squared (**The clock is the Node's, the tension is the Link's**, [the paces](#the-paces)); the six Ports and the wall's 6 in w = 6 den Gamma^2 are the three directions twice, so the six follows from the three; in time the rule is a three-level recurrence (before, now, next), and in light's own line, num = den at the vacuum's paces, the three stands in the open: a_next = the six arrivals over 3 minus a_before.

**The law in one line**: at every Node, each interval, the division act below with its coefficients from the family's pair and the Node's paces; every level on the lattice is written by that same act ([a family's write](#the-primitives)), every count is a reading of the record, its share over its family's quantum, W_c sin omega_0 for a gapped family and W_c for a massless one (row 12 of **The conventions and the units**) ([the count is the record's share](#the-count-is-the-records-share)), and everything else is a number in a file. each of its six Links, the self coefficient S_i, the level a_now at the interval's
start, a_before one interval earlier, and the remainder r kept at the Node:

w a_next + r' = SUM over the six Ports of R_ij arr_j + S_i a_now - w a_before + r,
0 <= r' < w,

arr_j the **arrival** through the Port to the neighbour j: the neighbour's level; the row's rest beyond an open face, 0 where the rest is 0;
the Node's own level on a folded axis. The remainder r is the Node's own
and never travels.

### The direction

Let sigma be the direction, +1 forward and -1 backward, and let div and
mod be the floor division and its remainder in [0, w), and rho the
remainder carried in. With

u = sigma (SUM_a R_a arr_a + S x - w y) + rho,
z = sigma (u div w), rho' = u mod w,

forward (x, y, rho) = (a_now, a_before, r) gives (z, rho') = (a_next, r');
backward (x, y, rho) = (a_now, a_next, r') gives (z, rho') = (a_before, r).

**Proof**. Forward, sigma = 1, the line is the definition of div and mod.
Backward, sigma = -1: write Y for the right side's first two terms, SUM_a
R_a arr_a + S a_now. Then u = w a_next - Y + r', and z = -floor(u / w) =
ceil((Y - w a_next - r') / w). From the forward line, Y - w a_next - r' = w
a_before - r with 0 <= r < w, whose ceiling divided by w is a_before
exactly; and rho' = u - w floor(u / w) = w a_before - (Y - w a_next - r') =
r. So the backward call returns (a_before, r) bit for bit; the reversibility
of every run needs no second function. The backward act is exact when w > 0
and every carried remainder lies in [0, w), which the engine's lays keep (the
half wall at birth, the rest's own remainder for a held row the half wall w div 2 too, **Every Node's remainder is born at the half wall**, [the generator](#the-generator)); a remainder
outside the range would be inverted to the wrong level; the rule is on
whole numbers of any size and carries no bound: on Python's unbounded
integers there is no wrap and the inverse holds for every level; the engine
that runs the rule in the hardware's fixed-width integers promises the
rule's numbers up to a level A it derives from its width and refuses above
it, the engine's statement and no line of the law (ENGINE.md, The amplitude bound). Checked bit for bit on 20,000 random
cases against a forward and a backward function written separately.

### The four acts

Rule3's line is one act; declared coefficients make it four:

(a) **The read**, the line above over the lattice (the six arrivals); (b) **The one-Node step**, the line with the neighbours' reads declared 0: a_next +
a_before = (a / b) a_now, the rotation by the angle whose doubled cosine is
a / b (Chebyshev's recurrence); with a / b = 1 and the coefficient on
a_before declared 0 it keeps a level; with a / b = 2 from (0, 1) it counts,
a_t = t; (c) **The division**, the line with R = S = 0: w a_next + r' = the
numerator + r, Euclid's division with the remainder kept; (d) **The load**, a
declared integer in the numerator, how a count enters a level.

**A composition** of Rule3's acts with declared coefficients is a finite
sequence of these acts, each with its coefficients (a pair, a weight, a
wall, a load) declared in the files, applied to declared levels.

**Theorem** (what the acts can form). Every composition of the four acts is
a piecewise-linear function of the levels with integer slopes: a sum of
linear forms and of floors of linear forms, composed. No such function
is quadratic in the levels.

**Proof**. Each act is a linear form of the levels or the floor of one; a
floor of a linear form is piecewise linear with integer slopes; sums and
compositions of piecewise-linear functions with integer slopes are of
the same kind: each act applied to an affine form plus a term bounded by
a constant returns an affine form with rational coefficients plus a term
bounded by a constant of the composition (a floor of y is y less a fraction
in [0, 1)), so every fixed finite composition on Z^n is affine plus bounded,
while a product now_i before_j grows as n^2 along now_i = before_j = n (R145,
and).
So nothing bilinear comes from the acts alone.

What the theorem separates: every product of two levels in the engine
is a **booking**, a reading of a bilinear form with declared
coefficients and no write ([the booking](#the-booking)); the one thing written from a
product is a held row's source (the write of the form, the Wronskian's quanta and the tension, [the primitives](#the-primitives)); the count is a product read and never written ([the count is the record's share](#the-count-is-the-records-share)), and its change is Rule3's own conserved current.

**The three tests of every rule**. A line enters the law only if it is
generic (one primitive with declared integers, no family's name and no
kind), vector (one of the acts on the state, no root and no float) and
local (its own record and the six neighbours, nothing kept at a Node
beyond the law's numbers). A hypothesis that needs more is stated under
its own name, outside the law.

## The stable body

### What a body is

A body is its count and its record over its Nodes; a record of count one may stand at one Node, a NodeDetector with Nodes alone never (**The NodeDetector is one declaration kind for every world**); a body of many quanta is many Nodes, and nothing gathers it. The particles of nature are quanta of declared families and not pixels: the electron and the nucleons are each one quantum of its own family, an electron one quantum of count 1, orders below the pixel threshold 0.23 Gamma (13 at Gamma = 6,000 with nature's sin omega_e over the count's old unit, 3 with [2, 3]'s 0.745; R189 and R194; **The bound body is one Node**, [a family's declaration](#a-familys-declaration)), and nothing smaller than a quantum clicks, the click crediting a whole quantum of a record and never a line or a fraction of it (derived); mass is the family's gap, T sin omega_s, bound or free, and what needs a bound body is a place and a lasting existence, a free packet spreading by the band's inertia (derived); what decays is a body, a quantum parted from it by a click at its front or a breathing body writing at its beat, and a quantum never breaks, having no part the click credits (derived), so an atom's decay is a body's and the neutron's end is the conversion, a click with no rate (a finding by name; **The conversion**); and no quantum of nature's families is a pixel, since a quantum of the gap omega_s on fewer Nodes than its Compton length 1 / (sqrt 3 omega_s) Links has its rotation at the band's scale and its energy T, the Link's own, 1.4 PeV or more at the LHAASO bound: the pixel is the lattice's compact body at the Link's energy and no particle. The two slits' and Bell's worlds lay no body (the source a laid packet, the wall a declared face, the detector a declared instrument, a body of the board with two sides **The click writes on the lattice**, [the click is the meeting](#the-click-is-the-meeting)); a body is the law's name for a standing count, matter, and its algebra below stands parked with the pixel; the compact branch's window, its edge and its upper edge the horizon at Gamma div 2, are the quadratic forms' numbers, recomputed by the generator under the composed paces as lattice readings, where no content within the width's reach (**The clusters' cosmology** (3), [a family's declaration](#a-familys-declaration); R208) closes a Link and the write at a body's own Nodes carries its own level (**The compact pixel under the composed paces** below; **The paces compose**, [the paces](#the-paces); [what is open](#what-is-open), item 29). The count c_i is its family's count at the body's Nodes, in quanta; it enters Rule3 through the pace alone, p_i = Gamma (1 - 1 / Gamma)^c with c the held levels at the Node (the composed paces, **The paces compose**; R46 with R68), x = (L_b + L_g) / Gamma, the binding holder's level and gravity's read at the weight 1 (the well of every record, D_i div T, laid into the two holders, the binding holder at the level weight 1 and the massless holder at the file's LW: the decision), and it is a reading of the record, its share in quanta over its family's quantum, W_c sin omega_0 (row 12 of **The conventions and the units**).
